Get there early.
Own your place.

Find promising products early. Get a limited Pass with a clear Advantage and your own serial. Use what it gives you, keep it, or sell it later when the Market opens.

Explore Debuts
Create a Debut

HOW IT WORKS
It works in three moves.
01
Find a launch you like

Discover lists every Debut before it opens. You can read the product, see what the Pass includes, and check the terms while everything is still public.

02
Get a numbered Pass

Buy while the Debut is open. Your serial is assigned the moment your purchase confirms, and the Pass is yours to keep or trade.

03
Use it, keep it, or sell it

The builder honours what your Pass includes, and their profile explains how to claim it. If you sell, whatever you have not used goes with the Pass.
